description:
## Goal

Remove compatibility models, cutover narratives, and test scaffolding whose replacements already own production behavior. Preserve only concepts with a current producer, consumer, or enforced contract.

## Signal

Each child proves the surviving authority before deletion, removes the obsolete model completely, and passes focused tests, the full library suite, fixture matrix where applicable, formatting, workspace checks, and clippy with warnings denied. Compiler-work telemetry must remain unchanged or improve; no compatibility shim or tombstone comment may replace deleted code.

## Strategy

Work from isolated leaves toward shared infrastructure:

1. Delete residual fixture-budget metadata and APIs.
2. Remove no-op LTO compatibility modes.
3. Retire the completed Compiler2 migration narrative and impossible old-pipeline sentinels.
4. Delete the orphaned SemanticClosure snapshot model.
5. Delete unreachable partial-key arrow merge branches.
6. Delete the always-empty latent-executable analysis channel.
7. Finish the dynamic-to-typed telemetry migration after the concurrent recalculator telemetry work lands.

The sequence is a dependency DAG and a GitHub stack. One child is one commit, one close, and one pull request. Temporary worktrees isolate every branch from active recalculator work.

## Boundaries

Per-derivation scheduling remains governed by fz-kdt.68 and is removed only if its measured experiment is refuted. BuildBackendProduct remains outside this epic because its bounded inner-compilation role is intentional and is being revisited by the recalculator work. Fixture ownership and TODO-only port tests remain governed by fz-kdt.78; this epic does not create a competing inventory model.

## Pull requests

The linear changes are managed through GitHub stack #112. The earlier fixture-budget PR is standalone because its branch predates the stack.
title: Retire completed migrations and abandoned compiler concepts
